title: The Fortieth Verse
summary: Mother Coke will teach a shaman of yours the fortieth verse, the one that stops rhyming. It wants singing in the Forgehall, where Oruth can hear it.

steps.journal: The Forgehall of Oruth, the first floor or below: hold six waves.

ready: The verse is sung in the Forgehall. Tell Mother Coke.
done: Your shamans know the fortieth verse. Mother Coke says they sing it flat.
